The adapter now uses the v3 named `Common` export and v3 `Common.custom(..., { hardfork })` options, while preserving the legacy `chainIdBN`, numeric `param`, and patched `copy` methods expected by the current `@ethereumjs/tx` integration and existing tests. Only source code was changed.
